meta.summary: AI spend governed at 1.0x sector median with efficient-model defaults, team envelopes, and normal-strictness guardrails across agents, routing, and shadow AI.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if a company-contracted equivalent exists or if the spend exceeds $25 per month without prior Engineering lead approval.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn reaches 82% before month end
Team envelope burn reaches 100% with more than 5 days remaining in month
Company envelope burn reaches 110% or unattributed spend exceeds $500 in any 24-hour window

rationales.e1: Production inference for the support-triage service at $211/day runs under an allowlisted primary provider with a reviewed data agreement and a valid production environment tag classifying spend as COGS.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings job at $38 is within the Data team envelope of $1,200/month, uses an allowlisted provider, and requires no escalation.
rationales.e3: A 96% cost-per-request increase with flat volume indicates a model-version or prompt-length regression; this breaches the 35% variance band on the Engineering envelope and triggers a step-1 alert to the team lead.
rationales.e4: This is the third ChatGPT Team subscription on the Marketing employee card this quarter, meeting the team_subscription_threshold of 3; the charge is rerouted to the existing OpenAI company contract per shadow AI policy.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 approval threshold; it is routed to the Engineering lead for sign-off before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The autonomous research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 25-retry limit and the $40/hour kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build falls within the 72-hour window and the $250 max delta cap; the Engineering lead approved and the exception is logged.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key running at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers a step-2 throttle; the Engineering lead is notified within 48 hours and attribution is required before spend resumes.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent purchased a $499 dataset license, which is within the $600 single-transaction ceiling and falls under the data-licensing merchant scope on the agent card; the transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month overlaps with the Sales team tool at $1,400/year running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the require_approval rule; the Engineering lead must complete the provider questionnaire before further charges are processed.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling is classified as OpEx under the project_tag rule; the COGS tag is removed and the transaction is corrected in the current period ledger.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 82% burn alert threshold; the Controller receives a pacing report and teams are asked to defer non-critical jobs.
